scope: Manual clarity and factual pass on player error messages, reward notifications, and victory/draw/defeat presentation. Follow-up correction to the Academy dummy dialogue.
method: Reviewed player-client message inventories and the relevant rendering branches. Traced changed outcome and payout claims to the server engine, settlement receipt, or recovery path. Retained protocol identifiers and gameplay rules.

inventory.note: Inventory candidates include CSS tokens, diagnostic strings, and narrative text; these are discovery counts, not unique revised messages.

findings.issue: The Academy reward instruction erased a supernatural story fact.
findings.resolution: The instruction now recalls the dummy repeating the vow and the companion hearing it. It does not assert an unconfirmed explanation such as literal possession.

findings.issue: A zero-ryo win could be mislabeled as practice even when stat points were awarded.
findings.resolution: Reward narration reads each confirmed grant and uses the actual spar flag. A reduced payout is distinguished from a stopped ryo payout.

findings.issue: Endless Tower called an unclaimed wave total banked ryo and announced loss consequences before confirmation.
findings.resolution: Wave rewards say they enter the unclaimed run total. Losses use the existing retryable settlement state before asserting a loss of ryo or showing Hospital navigation. Milestone currencies remain kept.

findings.issue: Weekly Boss announced delivered rewards at expiry or allocation, before individual credits were confirmed.
findings.resolution: Allocated rewards are labeled scheduled/pending. Confirmed delivery requires the player credit marker or a completed historical distribution listing the player. A successful gear roll is no longer presented as a guaranteed gear grant because pickGearDrop can return no upgrade.

findings.issue: Ambiguous failures claimed no changes or no active fight after a response was lost.
findings.resolution: Messages describe an unconfirmed result and tell the player where to check before repeating the action.

findings.issue: Draws, loss headings, and technical result language obscured the outcome.
findings.resolution: Draw and defeat labels are explicit. Pending Hollow Gate results no longer default to Run ended. Confirmed rewards and pending progress use ordinary language.

gameplayChanges: No reward rates, resource costs, combat formulas, difficulty, or progression requirements changed. Endless loss presentation now uses the existing settlement/retry path on every terminal outcome.
